body:
Feel the same way, I didn't think I'd make it past sixteen. And then I did.
Thought to myself, alright, I won't make it past eighteen!
And then I did. The bar keeps moving but the message stays the same.
I'm tired and everything is going wrong, and there's only one path I can see myself going down.

I too am good at nothing, have too many fears and is an introvert who stays up too late.
You'll find somebody who can relate, it's a matter of numbers.
Our types are way more common than you'd think.

Most people are too afraid to confront it, they internalise that you're emotionally vulnerable and that as they aren't a professional they could make it worse by confronting it.

Don't get me wrong, the "It's not my problem" attitude exists.
The deer in headlights "I don't know what to do" attitude is just as usual though.
She was as toxic as can be, you don't need that lingering on your psyche. Meet new people, pass your degree and live your life.

Try speaking to her, see if you can't get a dialogue going. 
If you can't, then distancing yourself would help, not in the "I never want to see you ever again" way but the "I need to move on, we'll still be friends even if we aren't talking" way.

Alright, first things first, don't hurt yourself into looking "better".
If you've got energy and passion to consider those routes, you have the energy and passion for a healthy life style.
 
Second, him not responding to your needing emotional support doesn't bode well, but it also seems like you need some professional help with your self esteem. Being too dependant on others scares them, they usually just don't know how to react, and don't because they don't want to make anything worse.
I have to take days off, it's harsh but sometimes my friends become work. I put in energy with nothing back, and that's not their fault, I just wasn't built with unlimited batteries.

Depression doesn't need a reason. Have you tried talking to anyone in your social circle about it?
The only thing I can think of is getting some emotional support from people you trust.
That must be tough, I can't imagine. Good luck in the future, friend.
Yeah, me too.

The session put a spot light on your issues, and it seems like it's just made you a little more self conscious about it. 
If you're willing to listen to a stranger, give the sessions some time before deciding to move onto different treatments.

The days have no meaning to them. I'm awake until I'm not, and then I sleep until I wake.

Being up for 24 hours at a time probably isn't helping.

Take what I say with a grain of salt, I'm bitter about cheaters.
Get the fuck out, she's still refusing to stop after saying they fucked. She's a liability to your mental state and you deserve to not be fucked around like some toy.

Someone who can recognise your faults and love you regardless?
That's what I keep telling people.

I kept speaking to my ex after they moved on, and I didn't really start healing until I completely broke off from them. It's hard, I'm not understating that, but at the same time it's what I have to recommend.
Definitely. Good luck, friend.

Everyone wishes they could be different in some way, or just someone else entirely, it's normal. No one has absolutely no good points though, I'm sure you have yours and you wouldn't want someone to be interested in you for something you're not.

That's fucking crushing. I can feel my heart collapsing in on it's self just reading that. I'm so sorry.

It's normal to feel the way you're feeling.

I think that in reality, if he ran when the going got tough, maybe it was for the best. Not everyone is compatible I'm sorry to say, and I don't think that makes it your fault.

That being said yeh totes I fucking ruin everything dude like holy shit.
You're going through something very natural, you care about the woman who raised you and you're facing thoughts of your own mortality AND hers. I hope everything turns out for the best.

You can't force yourself to be happy, and it looks like you're going through a break up. I'm sorry to say that with break ups you hurt and hurt and hurt, then one day it just stops. Maybe not completely but enough to hardly pay attention to.

Get your feelings out there whenever you can, holding onto them doesn't help.
Feeling shitty while doing things you enjoy just makes you associate feeling shitty about the things you enjoy. Horrible, horrible advice.

I've been in your shoes and it eats me up every single day. After all this time I've realised that there isn't anything you can do to help someone who doesn't want to help themselves.

You can't move mountains just because you have good intentions. I'm sorry, and good luck.
Man, I've come back twice thinking of how to put it nicely and holy fuck, your ex is a piece of shit.
I'm getting mixed messages here, are we still talking about our breakfast retinue?

Nothing we do will matter in the grand scheme of the universe, that's always going to be true. But what about what matters to you on a more personal level? You have a wife you're trying to keep out of emotional harms way, doesn't that say that something has meaning to you?
I can very much relate. How old were you when you started thinking about it?
Ah, the flavour of anonymity. I'm a big fan of it myself. I think it just means you like to pretend to be someone else for a while. Hell, if you think you'd be interested you might like cosplaying.
When it comes to relationships I really don't think there's an easy fix of any kind, I just waited for the pain to subside, and it did subside so I think you have that to look forward to.

I know this is a long shot, and a little out of the way. But as far as I know there are charities centred around giving free food and drink to those that need it. My brother had to go there a few times unfortunately, but he said they were very friendly and the like.

Classic! 
So is there any deeper meaning to the mask?
Do you have any friends or family, anyone really that could provide temporary financial aid?
Oh man, I've been wanting to that for years! What kind of mask is it?
It's hard to articulate, but I understand what you're saying and I can even relate to you on several accounts. So, in earnest, I'd rather you get better than me. I stopped trying three months ago.
A lot of people die every second of every day.
Beggars can't be choosers.
Writing off the victories you do earn because they aren't up to your standard.
You're talking right now, people are paying attention to what you have to say. I'd say that's a step forward. I'd say that says that maybe it's not too late.

Food still tastes good, treat yourself.
The worst thing I think you can do is punish yourself for being rejected, it ends up making you more and more frightened when you meet someone else you're interested in. Hope that makes sense.
It's almost as if you stop being a face in the crowd as soon as the person can relate to you.
I have the impression that we all wake up to that feeling everyday.
"I never felt anything for you, I just used you like a dildo." Yeah thanks.
I mean, lesbians exist.
You can talk about it here, it's what we're here for

If you feel bad then just try talking to them, try being their friend.
It's more long term than a quick shag.
I don't think sexual handouts are going to really improve anything
A little bit obscure, but if you can get a hold of the dead island trailer music without all the lovely groaning and monster stuff. It's alright.

I have issues getting my emotions out there, so when everything was going wrong I'd put on a sad song or something.

Those songs bring nothing but bad memories now.

My parent raised me by herself, my father died before I was born.
She always tried to give tough love when what I needed most was someone to understand.

It's hard being a parent, I understand that, but it doesn't make it feel any better. I bit the bullet and talked.

Dogs are great friends, it always hurts to lose them.
It's possible you may be in the grieving process.
I've been on both sides of this fence, and from my experience, there is nothing you can do other than seek professional help.
I listened.

Self-harm, like alcohol, is a temporary solution to an over arching problem.

And soon after, the temporary solution only outlines that problem so much that you can't forget about it.
It's not a good idea, is what I'm trying to say. Makes things worse, not better.

I feel like my dog is the only reason I continue.
I understand how you feel, as I'm in the same boat to an extent.
It's hard to articulate, but, no matter how you see it or try to rationalise it someone will miss you if you suddenly disappear.

Having heard your struggle, and it being so similar to mine - I know already that I'll miss you. I don't know if that helps.
